name: Primitive Farming
desc: Though more akin to gardening given the primitive local tools, the ancient root of civilization remains dug into this planet's extraordinary soil. While the vestiges of this industry have at least survived, it would take resources and heavy machinery for it to thrive.

name: Farming
desc: Agriculture is a trade and technology as old as civilization itself. Armed with modern technology and heavy equipment, local farmers can now combat the jungle's encroachment at scale. Food production has been greatly enhanced, but keeping the jungle at bay will require continual input of supplies and equipment.

name: Farming
desc: The once verdant fields of Gilead have been desecrated by fire and fallout from the heavens.

name: Knights of Ludd Planetary Garrison
desc: A massive facility, this garrison coordinates enhanced security efforts and patrols across the planet and in orbit. The Knights of Ludd have brought stability and security back to Gilead. However, it is also a constant reminder to the people of their loss of innocence.

name: Domain Algae Processor
desc: A vast Domain-era complex that extracts volatile and organic chemicals from the unique algae flourishing in the acidic swamps that cover much of this world. A byproduct of this process is a foul-smelling sludge that is edible if properly prepared.  The decaying complex is being maintained through dangerous manual labor and improvised repairs.

name: Ashen Fuel Production
desc: Placeholder

name: Ashen Mining
desc: Built into the site of a gigantic impact long ago, The plentiful rare metals would normally require heavy equipment, special infrastructure, and a skilled workforce to extract. The Crusade has found an alternative with 'less-than-willing personnel'. Prisoners taken during the Crusade's war effort labor here under gruelling conditions, regulated with stimulants and tranquilizers. An efficient and brutal system

name: Ashen Refining
desc: Metal and metalloid ores are refined here to feed the relentless demands of the Crusade's war effort.

name: Ashen Light Industry
desc: Civilian manufacturing has been pressed into service by the Crusade's war effort, sustaining the population under increasingly harsh conditions.

name: Ashen Heavy Industry
desc: Heavy manufacturing has been pressed into service by the Crusade's war effort, producing machinery, supplies, weapons, and ships under harsh conditions.

name: Ashen Orbital Works
desc: Expanded orbital manufacturing facilities improve the quality of ships produced for the Crusade's war effort.

name: Ashen Patrol HQ
desc: A fortified command center coordinating the Crusade's local security patrols.

name: Ashen Military Base
desc: A major military installation coordinating the Crusade's system patrols and defensive fleets.

name: Ashen High Command
desc: A hardened fleet command nexus directing the Crusade's war effort.

name: Refugee Processing Center
desc: A humane facility for integrating displaced people into the colony through housing, food, and work programs. Eases the strain refugees place on order -- at a cost.

name: Security Forces
desc: A decentralized network of security offices, checkpoints, detention facilities, and armed response units. Maintains order and restricts disruptive population movement, provided it remains adequately staffed and armed.

name: Independent Salvage
desc: Unaffiliated scavengers with no real infrastructure, breaking down derelict hulls and dead cities for metal, parts, and makeshift goods. Improvised, fuel-hungry, and never with enough to go around.

name: Wildcat Mining
desc: Refugees squat on a rare-ore vein and are stripping it with improvised mining rigs. The density of the vein is allowing the miners to pull much more ore than a colony this size should -- and it's far more than New Maxios will tolerate.

name: Broken Siphon
desc: A defunct Domain-era gas siphon, dark and silent. Like the rest of the sector, the refugees seem to lack the parts and the expertise to bring it online.

name: Makeshift Gas Mining
desc: The old siphon has been coaxed back to a semblance of life with improvised repairs. It's pulling volatiles up from the planet efficiently enough to be called "production".

name: Broken Processor
desc: A wrecked volatiles-to-fuel processor. Until it runs, the siphon's output is just raw gas.

name: Jury-Rigged Processor
desc: Held together by scavenged adhesives and stubbornness, the station's emergency backup processor is now producing small quantities of fuel -- a precious thing in the sector today.

name: Mysterious Stockpiles
desc: Warehouses that are never empty and manifests that never reconcile. Hulls, munitions, and machine parts flow out of holds that no freighter was ever seen filling. Nobody asks where it comes from. Nobody who asked is available for comment.
